steps.note: app stores '' for guest orders first
backfill the old NULLs in batches
steps.sql: DO $$ DECLARE lo bigint := 0; hi bigint; BEGIN SELECT max(id) INTO hi FROM orders; WHILE lo <= hi LOOP UPDATE orders SET email = '' WHERE id > lo AND id <= lo + 50000 AND email IS NULL; COMMIT; lo := lo + 50000; END LOOP; END $$;

steps.note: email: NOT NULL via a validated CHECK
steps.sql: SET lock_timeout = '3s'; ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT email_not_null CHECK (email IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;

steps.note: validate the check (scans, but doesn't block writes)
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT email_not_null;

steps.note: SET NOT NULL (instant: the check proves it), drop the check
steps.sql: SET lock_timeout = '3s'; ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN email SET NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT email_not_null;
